### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [Keep usage bars off red, raise side-panel text, tell same-named models apart](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3468) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — On the Usage pages, latency bars are grey and average-token bars green, so red means errors only. The expanded sessions panel uses larger text, and Customize · Models shows the namespace of models that share a name.
